fields.description: Choose the criteria for summarizing multiple payments before processing the Payment Order.

fields.description: If enabled, a notification will be sent to the party’s email when the payment status becomes "Processed".
fields.label: Notify Party

fields.description: If enabled, workflows will be activated for Bank Account DocType.
fields.label: Activate Workflow on Bank Account

fields.description:
If enabled, payments will always be processed in the background to avoid bank request timeouts.
If disabled, only batches with more than 10 payments will be processed in the background.

fields.description: If enabled, the posting date of the Payment Entry will be updated to match the actual payment date from the bank.
fields.label: Update Posting Date to Match Payment Date

fields.description: If enabled, the status of each payment order will be fetched automatically.
fields.label: Auto Update Payment Status

fields.label: Status Check Frequency
fields.options:
Every 20 Minutes
Every Hour
Every Day at Midnight

fields.description: Number of days to retry fetching the status of processed payments from the initiation date.
fields.label: Retry Period (in Days)

fields.description: If enabled, the Payment Entry date will be set to the Payment Order date.
fields.label: Use Payment Order Date as Payment Entry Date

fields.description: If enabled, Payment Orders can be created with future dates.
fields.label: Allow Future-Dated Payment Orders
